exact: initiation of blood coagulation cascade, tissue factor pathway

definition: A protein activation cascade that initiates blood coagulation, starting with a signal from tissue factor (TF), a cell-surface, integral-membrane protein, which converts Factor IX to IXa, and Factor IXa converts Factor X to Xa. Factor Xa then initiates the common pathway.
label: Extrinsic Pathway of Fibrin Clot Formation
